about: Short labels for the HUD, edited by hand. alias: shown instead of the full text (empty = full text); '#' is replaced by the next read value, '#2' by the second one. icon: file name in ui/modules/altar/img/mods/ without .png. text is a reference copy refreshed by tools/gen_mods; edits to it are overwritten.
